title: A Constitutive Markov Physics-Informed Neural Operator (MPNO) for Autoregressive Stability in Transient Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.25744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators applied to transient-dynamics PDEs with strong discontinuities exhibit autoregressive instability: in concrete-penetration stress-field prediction, the wavelet neural operator (WNO) diverges in autoregressive rollout, while MeshGraphNets collapse to zero predictions. WNO's instability stems from the lack of a structural constraint on the spectral radius of its propagation operator; the Fourier neural operator (FNO) is stable in these measurements but only emergently, not by construction. We propose a constitutive Markov physics-informed neural operator (MPNO) modeling one-step evolution as a Markov (row-stochastic) propagation operator. Physics-coupled edge weights (acoustic-impedance harmonic mean, contact area, and traction amplitude) encode material-interface constitutive information into a nonnegative symmetric adjacency matrix W; after normalizing the graph Laplacian L = D - W by lambda_max, the propagator P = I - a

translated_title: 一种用于瞬态动力学自回归稳定性的本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子（MPNO）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25744v1 公告类型：新 摘要：应用于具有强不连续性的瞬态动力学偏微分方程的神经算子在自回归过程中表现出不稳定性：在混凝土侵彻应力场预测中，小波神经算子（WNO）在自回归滚动中发散，而MeshGraphNets则崩溃为零预测。WNO的不稳定性源于其传播算子缺乏对谱半径的结构性约束；傅里叶神经算子（FNO）在这些测量中是稳定的，但只是涌现性的，而非通过构造保证。我们提出了一种本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子（MPNO），将单步演化建模为马尔可夫（行随机）传播算子。物理耦合的边权重（声阻抗调和平均值、接触面积和牵引力幅度）将材料界面的本构信息编码到非负对称邻接矩阵W中；在通过λ_max归一化图拉普拉斯算子L = D - W后，传播子P = I - a
tldr: 本文提出一种本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子（MPNO），通过构造马尔可夫行随机传播算子并耦合物理本构信息，从根本上解决了瞬态动力学中神经算子的自回归不稳定性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constitutive Markov physics-informed neural operator (MPNO) that constructs a Markov row-stochastic propagator with physics-coupled constitutive information, fundamentally resolving autoregressive instability in transient dynamics neural operators.
